data.title: 在原七海 · 出发前的手套
data.description: 七海在储物柜前戴好手套，又检查了一遍随身的联络设备。柜门合上后，她确认帽檐没有挡住视线。
data.action: adjusting a white glove beside an open locker
data.promptProse: In a quiet prep locker room, Nanami stands before an open metallic locker, meticulously pulling on and adjusting a crisp white glove. Soft ambient lighting catches the sheen of clean equipment hung within the locker, while rows of industrial lockers in the background create a structured, operational environment before departure.
